content:
**OPNduck v0.2.1-Alpha** 🦆 - critical patch

v0.2.0-Alpha was effectively unusable once actually installed (as opposed to run from the dev server) - reported after installing fresh on a Windows machine. This patches it.

**Fixed**
• Navigation was completely broken in the packaged app: `BrowserRouter` needs a real HTTP server to resolve routes, but a packaged Electron app loads `index.html` via `file://` with no server at all, so no page ever rendered and nav links did nothing. Switched to `HashRouter`, which needs no server.
• Social icons were missing in the packaged app: hardcoded absolute icon paths (`/icons/x.png`) resolved to the OS filesystem root under `file://` instead of the app's asset root. Now built from Vite's `BASE_URL`.
• Neither bug ever showed up in dev, because every test run up to this point used the Vite dev server, never the actual packaged build. Added renderer console-message forwarding to the Electron main process so a packaged app's JS errors are no longer invisible.

If you installed v0.2.0-Alpha and nothing worked, this is why - please grab v0.2.1-Alpha instead.
